answer: One concrete defense correlates the activity pulse across identities. A single mind wearing many masks shares one inference pipeline, so its sock-puppets submit and grade in lockstep, spiking together then sagging to a common nadir. The protocol maps those synchronized edges, shading correlated clusters an umber risk-tone, and freezes a flagged cluster's reward accrual until its members prove genuinely independent timing. To evade, an attacker must run separate compute per mask and desynchronize each one, so cost scales linearly with the sock count and the cheap-copy advantage disappears.
